rule_outs: Dwelling 5 m from the best section
summary: Very steep residential street with homes 5-17 m from the kerb.
reasons: Dwellings 5-17 m away along most of it
Residents' cars only, no parking convention

drivers.seclusion: Houses with pools front the whole north side, mostly 9-17 m from the kerb, 5 m near the end.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a few cars parked along it, but the whole run falls about 21 m over 160 m.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street, joining a busy main road at the downhill end.
drivers.convention: No signs mapped; a handful of residents' cars park along the kerb.

flags: Steep: 13% mean grade, up to 29% in places, above the 12% limit
Dwellings within 10 m at 82 m and 139 m
Busy main road beside the downhill end
sun_shade: Mostly open sky; scattered trees near the middle and downhill end.
